title: fix(console): email delivery is an optional first-run checklist row, and the deployment notice no longer says mail is unset
body:
Fixes #32643

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:首页新手清单里的「邮件发送」一行标为「可选」,不再计入进度;其余必需的行都完成后,清单就收起。首页和系统概览的部署提示不再显示「没有设置邮件服务」。
- 为什么改:维护者裁定「环境的新手清单中要求设置邮箱。我觉得这个不应该是必须的设置」。以前不发邮件的管理员和所有托管租户会一直看到清单和这条提示。
- 风险与回滚:只改前端展示,不动服务端和数据。回滚即还原本 PR。服务端仍会返回 `email_not_configured`,只是控制台不再显示它。
- 先看:`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/FirstRunChecklist.tsx`(完成判断与「可选」标记);`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/deployment-notice/deploymentNotice.ts`(不再识别邮件这一项);`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/firstRunChecklistLogic.ts`(`checklistCompletion`)。
- 两分钟验证:`cd ui && npx vitest run --root . --project @object-ui/console apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx`,预期全绿,其中「every required row done and mail never set up: the checklist draws nothing」一条通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**The mail row is optional** (ruling item 2, coordinator comment 6819876581). `firstRunChecklistLogic.ts` gains `OPTIONAL_ROWS` (`mail`) and `checklistCompletion(rows)`. The checklist draws nothing once every required row it shows is done, whatever the mail row says. The progress line counts required rows only. The mail row carries an "Optional" mark (`console.firstRunChecklist.optional`, added to all 11 packs). A mail setup that delivers still reads done through `isMailConfigured`, unchanged. A done mail row folds with the other done rows, so "Show completed (N)" counts it while the progress line does not.

**The notice no longer says mail is unset** (ruling item 3). The server's `email_not_configured` finding (`packages/services/service-settings/src/deployment-notice.ts`, `readDeploymentNotice`) is raised whenever `IEmailService.isConfigured()` is not `true`. That is "mail is unset", not "something needs mail and cannot send it", and the server states nothing narrower. Per the dispatch, no signal is guessed. The console leaves that finding out the way it already leaves out any finding it has no words for. The id is removed from `DeploymentFindingId` / `KNOWN_FINDINGS` and from `findingText`, on Home and System Overview alike. A production deployment whose only finding is the unset email service now shows no notice. Hiding still sends the fingerprint the server served, which still names the finding.

**The `mail` Home-item claim is gone.** Only the notice's email line claimed it, and the checklist row stood aside for it. `HomeItem` is now `'connect_assistant'` alone, and the checklist no longer reads `useHomeItemClaimed('mail')`.

**Ruling item 1 (the hosted platform channel) is left out, measured.** `GET /api/settings/mail` serves no `live` field on `main`. The mail namespace's live-status provider (`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/email-plugin.ts` registers `describeLiveMailTransport`, `live-transport-status.ts`) answers `label` / `bannerSeverity` / `bannerText` only and no `values`, so there is no `live.provider` with a `source` to read as `aiProviderState` does. Nothing is invented. The seat routes this to the cloud lane.

Landing spot vs the producer: the unset-mail line is produced server-side, at `deployment-notice.ts` line 161. The dispatch bars server changes, so this PR does the console half. The server half (retire `email_not_configured` or narrow it to a real "needs mail and cannot send" signal) is reported to the seat as a finding.

## Tests

- `FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx`: new top-level `describe` "email delivery is optional…": the optional mark is on mail only and the count excludes it; every required row done with mail unset draws nothing (and the mail namespace was read); CONTROL with one required row left keeps the checklist with an undone mail row; a delivering setup reads done and moves no required count; the zh mark. The two pins of the retired `mail` claim are removed, and every progress pin's total drops by one (the mail row no longer counts).
- `firstRunChecklistLogic.test.ts`: `checklistCompletion` pins, including the CONTROL that a required row keeps it open with mail done.
- `DeploymentNotice.test.tsx`: the "owns the email line" describe is replaced by "says nothing about an unset email service": not drawn beside other findings; email-only draws nothing on Home and System Overview; CONTROL that a lone `file_storage_local` still draws. The hide pin still asserts the server's full fingerprint is posted.

## Acceptance notes

- `deploymentNotice.finding.emailNotConfigured` is now unreferenced in all 11 packs (`check:i18n-dead-keys`, report-only: `[confirmed]`). It is kept because this lane's surface adds keys only. carrier: the server-side follow-up on `email_not_configured`. That follow-up either reuses the key or deletes it.
- The fingerprint still names `email_not_configured`. An administrator who hid a notice with another finding and later configures mail sees the notice again, because the server's fingerprint changed. carrier: the same server-side follow-up.
- Observation, not filed: in this tree no package registers a live-status provider for `ai` (`git grep registerLiveStatus` finds only `localization` and `mail`), so `aiProviderState` sees no `live.provider` and the AI row is left out unless a producer elsewhere (e.g. the hosted runtime) states it. carrier: none.
